Home.title: Damascus University Journal
Home.intro: Authors submit manuscripts, editors assign reviewers, and accepted work appears in the public catalog—one account, role-based dashboards, editorial workflow.
Home.featureSubmitBody: Manuscripts and revisions in one queue with clear status at every step.
Home.featureReviewBody: Invites, assignments, and decisions—without losing context in email threads.
Home.featurePublicBody: Accepted work is discoverable with abstracts, authors, and stable links.
Home.heroAsideTitle: One workspace for authors, editors, and reviewers.
Home.heroAsideBody: Structured queues, role-based access, and a public face for accepted scholarship.

simulator.tabsHint: Click the tabs above to preview scholarly editorial steps

author.title: Submit Manuscript
author.details: Write your manuscript block-by-block. The system compiles a journal-compliant DOCX with bilingual support.

editor.title: Editorial Desk Triage
editor.details: AI automatically scans keywords and abstracts to suggest specific academic fields, enabling instant editor assignment.

reviewer.title: Double-Blind Review
reviewer.details: Download secure reviewer packages. Submit formatted evaluation reports to authors and private notes directly to editors.

copyeditor.title: Interactive Copyediting
copyeditor.details: Engage in multi-round query threads with authors. Upload final revised manuscripts and publish them directly to the open catalog.

timeline.heading: Scholarly Lifecycle Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Explore the five rigorous phases that secure scientific excellence from drafting to catalog listing.
timeline.step1Desc: Authors write section-by-section inside the Word Constructor or upload their preparated .docx files.
timeline.step2Desc: Handling editors evaluate the incoming manuscript, verify the academic scope, and assign peer reviewers.
timeline.step3Desc: Reviewers conduct secure double-blind evaluation of the review package, submitting separate logs for authors and editors.
timeline.step4Desc: Copyeditors raise structured rounds of author-facing queries to finalize typesetting and manuscript parameters.
timeline.step5Desc: The accepted scholarly article is instantly published to the public searchable catalog with abstracts and PDF links.
